x.instructions: For axis x, read state.processed_features.axes.x.goal_relation only. Choose positive for increase, negative for decrease, and hold for within_tolerance. Other axes do not determine this answer. Program-authored policy: For x, read state.processed_features.axes.x.goal_relation. Select positive for increase, negative for decrease, hold for within_tolerance. This corrects only the authorized high pose; do not infer clearance or possession.
